title: Dark Noise? Dark Patterns!
content: Die App zwingt gleich beim Start zum Kauf von Abos - wer nicht zahlt, kann sie nicht nutzen. Dass es sowas 2026 noch gibt … App wird direkt wieder gelöscht.

title: Nice app, dated sounds
content: The overall design and execution of the app are nice, however, some of the sounds sound a bit dated (e. g. „Thunderstorm“ with tinny rain sounds, „Heavy Rain“ sounds like it’s been recorded in a car).

title: Good
content: Very very Goooood!!!

title: Abo für Sound….
content:
Seit ihr GESPRITZT???
Dümmer gehts nümmer!

title: Geldgier
content: Ich mach die App frisch auf und das erste was mir entgegen kommt ist eine Abo bettelei 🤡 dann nehm ich halt die Sounds dies kostenlos auf YouTube gibt oder im Internet oder oder oder. Aber erstmal 23€ bettelbrief ins Gesicht werfen nach dem ersten Start der App ist maximal frech.

title: The best background noises app
content: Simple to use with great Apple systems integration, well done!

title: Schön aber überteuerte Blendung
content:
Schöne Idee mag auch helfen 
Aber mit knapp 23 Euro ist das Wucher 

Tim lässt grüßen 
Oder Banditen unter sich

title: Legacy users forced to upgrade
content: I bought the app before the "Pro" introduction and now I'm locked out of the sounds I had?

title: Almost perfect
content:
Extremely well designed and easy to use app. 
Unfortunately there’s a phone notification in my favourite sound: Coffee Shop. Who would want to hear that every minute?! Will never upgrade because of it.

title: Hammer / Awesome
content:
Ich bin mega begeistert von der App. 
Meine Kinder schlafen in nicht einmal fünf Minuten mit dem Staubsaugergeräusch ein. 
Definitiv fünf Sterne wert
Danke für die App. 

Absolut awesome app, I am so happy. 
My kids will be sleeping in five minutes with the vacuum sound. 

I give you definitely five stars !!! 
Thanks for the app.

title: Dark Noise helps me concentrate!
content: Like many software developers, I find it hard to concentrate on one thing sometimes: so much activitiv going on around me. With Dark Noise, it's like I'm entering my own private space ship: I turn on "space ship engine" in my headphones and disappear into hours of productivity and calm. I absolutely love it!

title: False Advertising
content: You cannot create custom mixes. I paid 9,99€ for a false advertising.

title: Great sounding App!
content: Most Apps have a very thin and artificial sound, this one doesn’t :)

title: Teils Störungen in den Tönen
content:
Generell würde mir die App echt sehr gefallen. Doch leider gibt es mit zwei Tönen Probleme.
Beim Grillenzirpen gibt es ein Hintergrund Geräusch wie von einem elektrischen Gerät. Beim Segelschiff gibt es eine deutlich hörbare Unterbrechung in der Abspielschleife.
Ohne diese Probleme wäre mir die App fünf Sterne wert.
Ich hoffe der Entwickler bessert nach, zumindest beim Segelschiff sollte das zu machen sein.

title: Dear developer
content:
I really appreciate  your app. But the only sound that is important to me and IMO many others is the rain sound. Unfortunately, it has the worst quality and sound very digital. Would please replace/add rain sound? Then the app will perfect.
Thanks

title: Great
content: Fantastic app, I’m using it every night!

title: Brilliant App
content: I used to listen to podcasts when showering but recently I switched to Dark Noise which brings more calm at the end of the day.

title: Useless
content: The app was recommended - why? The noises sound very artificial (those who are supposed to be ‘nature’) there are far better apps ... waste of money

title: Most sounds too distracting
content: I would like to see more lower pitch noises with repetitions. I’m currently using distant thunder a lot for study/work. Most other sounds are too distracting for me.

title: Sound quality is not that great
content: The selection of different sounds is great, but the overall sound quality really isn’t. Too bad, I requested a refund. I think Thunderspace has a way better sound quality even though it does not support AirPlay as this app does.

title: Klangqualität bescheiden
content: Die Sounds sind mono und klingen blechern. Der Funktionsumfang ansonsten ist gut.

title: Best white noise app by far
content: This app is shockingly awesome. I wouldn't have expected this much from a white noise app, but it really levels up -- very slick UI, and a wide range of soothing noises. (I never would have thought it possible for a lawn mower to sound that relaxing!) Do yourself a favor and spring for it -- it's totally worth it.
